label: Causability and cause
resolution: A7's possibly causing a situation with a certain cardinal lower bound is represented only by the index predicate in DEF-NB-COUNT-CAUSABILITY; Aquinas's actual innovative origin-cause relation in DEF-CAUSE-OF-ORIGIN is different. The finite-count theorem does not infer an actual cause or identify the modality, timing, or bearer of a possible cause. A7c steps 4–7 require separate interpretation and additional premises.
